title: Aster Helm values
description: Configuration contract for the Aster Helm chart. Cross-field and cluster-dependent constraints are also enforced by chart templates.

stringMap.description: A string-valued Kubernetes metadata or selector map.

tag.description: Container image tag. An empty value follows the chart image fallback.

imageTag.description: Shared image tag. Empty falls back to the chart appVersion.

fullnameOverride.description: Override for the fully qualified release name.

mode.description: Select the single dashboard data writer.

generation.description: Reversible cache generation. Empty preserves historical keys; nonnegative integers are also accepted.

agentSandbox.description: Consumer-installed Kubernetes SIG Agent Sandbox integrations for Fix PR execution and private analysis experiments.

analyzer.description: Private disabled-by-default OpenCode analyzer deployment guardrails without scheduled authority.

persistence.description: Shared dashboard output and AI cache storage.

enabled.description: Create or mount shared persistent storage.

retain.description: Retain chart-managed data when the release or claim changes.

storageClass.description: ReadWriteMany StorageClass name. Empty uses the cluster default.

mountPath.description: Shared volume mount path in dashboard containers.

project.description: Consumer project bundle mounted into dashboard workloads.

existingConfigMap.description: Existing ConfigMap containing project.yaml and system.md.

config.description: Inline project.yaml content, normally supplied with --set-file.

systemPrompt.description: Inline prompts/system.md content, normally supplied with --set-file.

skills.description: Consumer skill filename to YAML content map.

tag.description: Container image tag. An empty value follows the chart image fallback.

ai.description: AI provider coordinates and credential references.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional provider reasoning effort. Empty uses the provider default.

contextWindowTokens.description: Total provider context window. Use 0 for provider metadata or the engine fallback.

token.description: Inline provider token. Prefer existingSecret in production.

tokenSecretKey.description: Secret key containing the provider token.

githubReadToken.description: Inline read-only GitHub source token. Prefer githubReadTokenSecretName.

githubReadTokenSecretName.description: Existing read-only GitHub source credential Secret name.

githubReadTokenSecretKey.description: Secret key containing the GitHub read token.

schedule.description: Cron schedule used in cron mode.

restartPolicy.description: CronJob pod restart policy. Empty selects a runtime-specific default.

backoffLimit.description: CronJob retry limit. -1 selects a runtime-specific default.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: CronJob hard deadline. Zero omits the deadline.

buildsPerJob.description: Prow build history depth per job.

server.description: Dashboard API and SPA server configuration.

staticDir.description: Path to the SPA files in the server image.

allowInsecureHTTP.description: Explicitly acknowledge direct local HTTP serving when HSTS is disabled.

allowInsecureCookies.description: Allow OAuth cookies over local HTTP. Never enable in a deployed dashboard.

maxSessionsPerOwner.description: Maximum stored chat sessions per owner.

maxActiveTurnsPerOwner.description: Maximum active chat turns per owner.

actions.description: Authentication and GitHub write action settings shared with chat.

trustedOrigins.description: Additional public origins accepted by the CSRF guard.

clientSecret.description: Inline OAuth client secret. Prefer existingSecret.

sessionKey.description: Inline session encryption key. Prefer existingSecret.

botToken.description: Inline bot token for GitHub writes. Prefer existingSecret.

privateRepositories.description: Deprecated OAuth repository access switch. Remove this field and grant access to botToken instead.

existingSecret.description: Existing Secret containing OAuth credentials and BOT_TOKEN when actions are enabled.

scope.description: Deprecated OAuth scope override. OAuth now uses read:user and botToken performs writes.

chatScope.description: Deprecated chat OAuth scope override. OAuth now uses read:user and botToken performs writes.

botToken.description: Inline GitHub bot token. Prefer existingSecret.

secret.description: Inline proxy shared secret. Prefer existingSecret.

anyOf.description: Acknowledge intentional public LoadBalancer origin risk.

publicOriginAcknowledged.description: Acknowledge intentional public LoadBalancer origin risk.

remediationInvestigation.description: Authenticated on-demand causal remediation investigation settings.

enabled.description: Enable the authenticated read-only causal remediation operation.

maxOperations.description: Maximum retained in-memory safe operation states.

enabled.description: Enable preview generation without any GitHub write or confirmation capability.
Create a NetworkPolicy for server ingress.

podSecurityContext.description: Kubernetes PodSecurityContext applied to dashboard pods.

securityContext.description: Kubernetes container SecurityContext applied to dashboard containers.
